first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the two most directly relevant memories indicate that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improved time-to-value and durable SMB activation. A standard experiment is preferable to broad rollout because higher activation may not translate into qualified long-term revenue; downstream conversion and retention should be monitored. Targeted pricing remains a plausible response to competitor pressure, but onboarding addresses two current funnel failures without relying on ongoing discounts.
